item.tib: mkha' lding grub pa'i bstan bcos
mkha' lding grub pa'i bstan bcas
item.coloph: dpal mkha' lding grub pa'i bram ze shang kus mdzad pa rdzogs so/ /gu na sa ga ra/ 'dir ni bla ma dam pa'i rjes 'brangs te/ dpal ldan shang ku bdag gis mdor bsdus bris/ dge ba de yis srid gsum ma lus pa/ dug med bdud rtsi'i go phong bsten par shog /rgya gar gyi mkhan po dpal bram ze a ba d+hU tI pa che po dpe med kyi zhal sngar/ lo tsA ba ban+de pradz+nyA kIrtisa bsgyur ba'o// /dbang phyug chen pos mkha' lding du sprul nas mkha' lding rgya mtsho ba 'bum phrag bzhi bshad/ de bram ze sang kus dbang bskur gyi tshe klu bdun gyi dug yod pa la/ 'jog pa'i dug kham phor du mar dang sbrang rtsi byin pa ma yog /bdun po kun gyi bu mo nub mo bkug nas chung mar byas/ 'jog pa'i bkug pas mos phu byas pas dug gis zin nas shi la thug pas/ yul mi kun gyis khyed grong na nged kyi dug sus gso byas pas/ mchog sdong tshugs shig zir nas nam mkha' ldeng gi mchod sdeng rdo rings steng du btsug steng nas rdo'i gdugs phub pa gcig byas/ khos 'khyung nas sngags bzlas te/ kun du zhi bar byed do/ de lta bu'i shang kus mdzad do//dus dang dus ma yin pa lnga ste/ rma'i mtshan nyed dang / pho nya'i mtshan nyid dang / gnas dang /tshes grangs dang / gza' dang / rgyu skar dang / chos mthun pa dang / mi mthun pa dang / dus dang /dgos pa'i dbye ba dang / rags pa dang / stong pa ste dug zin gyi mtshan nyid dang /dus ma yin pa mi 'chi ba bstan pa'o//nyid dgos pa gsum/ phrin las thams cad kyi snod du 'gyur ba'i dgos pa dang / sems kyi srog 'dzin pa'i dang / phyogs thams cad du grags pas khyab pa'o/ mchod brdzod dang / dgod 'brel dang / gzhung bshad pa gsum mo/ gzhung la gnyis/ lus rnam gzhag dang / yan lag rgyas bshad do
